purpose: Single source of truth for distinguishing scheduled live runs of the graded DCA task from manual runs, so downstream slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never confuses the two. Every run_state artifact must carry a run_classification block matching this policy.
accepted_state_schema_versions_note: Downstream consumers (slippage 67aa802b, weekly 041d9d90) accept BOTH run-classification-v1 and the stricter successor run-classification-v2-preauthorized when the required scheduled identity fields (run_origin, manual_run, cron_id/supersedes_cron_id, scheduled_for_et, window, run_id) are correct. v2 (added 2026-07-10) is the pre-authorized direct-placement contract (no review_equity_order); it is a stricter successor of v1, not a different contract, so a v2 scheduled run_state is valid scheduled evidence and must not be discarded for its version alone.

live_task.lineage_note: 10ce362c is the repaired live task; it supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b. The artifact root stays under .../ce16ba6b for continuity across the repair.
live_task.forbidden_values_note: cron_id must be exactly '10ce362c' and supersedes_cron_id must be exactly 'ce16ba6b'. Placeholder or ambiguous values such as 'ce16ba6b_replacement' are forbidden anywhere a cron_id/supersedes_cron_id appears.
live_task.name: Graded DCA automatic live test - $2 allocation

scheduled_run_classification.lineage_rule: A scheduled run is valid evidence when cron_id='10ce362c' OR supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b', so continuity artifacts written before/after the repair both remain valid.
scheduled_run_classification.writer_contract: Every scheduled 3:20 PM ET run_state MUST be written with BOTH cron_id='10ce362c' AND supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b'. Valid scheduled state also requires run_origin='scheduled', manual_run=false, scheduled_for_et='15:20', and state_schema_version set to one of accepted_state_schema_versions ('run-classification-v1' or the stricter pre-authorized successor 'run-classification-v2-preauthorized'). Placeholder/ambiguous ids such as 'ce16ba6b_replacement' are forbidden.

scheduled_state_file_guarantee.summary: The 3:20 PM live task (10ce362c) MUST always write a scheduled run_state.json under scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/ and update latest_scheduled_run.json every time it fires, even when no order is placed. A confirmation-blocked run is a valid scheduled run that proves the task ran; it is NOT evidence of an order or fill.

order_submit_status_values.submitted: One or more orders were submitted; order_id(s) present on the corresponding buy_candidates.
order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_no_candidates: No ticker qualified for a buy; run_state is valid scheduled evidence with no orders.
order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_confirmation_required: Robinhood review passed but order submission was blocked by required post-review user confirmation. Valid scheduled evidence that the task ran; carries no order_id and is NOT evidence of an order/fill.
order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_error: An error prevented submission; run_state is still valid scheduled evidence and records the error.
order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_budget_exhausted: Budget/cap left no room to submit; valid scheduled evidence with no orders.

must_include: A valid scheduled run_classification block (passes run_classification.schema.json).
reviewed_order details on each affected buy_candidate where the review result is available.
candidate details (ticker, buy_multiplier, planned_amount_usd, status) for what would have been placed.
must_not_include: Any submitted/filled status implying an order was placed.
downstream_treatment: Watchdog (a46bf007): treat as a valid scheduled run that fired. Alert that no order was placed, but do NOT mark the lineage/scheduled state invalid when the required fields are present.

Slippage (67aa802b): report no scheduled fills and no scheduled order IDs. Do NOT invalidate the run_state just because confirmation blocked order submission; the broker time-window fallback does NOT apply (there was no write failure).
Weekly/monthly: count the scheduled run as having occurred; contribute zero scheduled fills/orders.

raw_input_persistence.reason: The 2026-07-10 3:20 PM ET scheduled run escalated because quotes and historicals were fetched successfully but the raw connector responses were never persisted to disk before signal computation; the bash compute step had no quotes_batchN.json / historicals_batchN.json to read.
rules: Before computing any signal, persist every raw Robinhood/Finance/Alpaca/Yahoo connector response used by the run under scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/raw/ with the deterministic filenames above.
Normalize large connector output_path pointers into parseable JSON before persisting (referenced contents under 'data', original pointer preserved under 'output_path').
Compute must read only the persisted/normalized files under raw/, never in-memory tool responses. Order of operations: fetch -> persist -> normalize -> compute -> place.

If raw persistence or normalization fails, still write a valid scheduled run_state (run_origin='scheduled', manual_run=false) with order_submit_status='not_submitted_error', raw_persistence_error set, empty raw_inputs_saved, and no orders placed, rather than escalating without state.
raw_input_persistence.broker_policy_unchanged: Robinhood only for execution; Alpaca/Finance/Yahoo read-only validation; no review_equity_order in scheduled live runs.

recovered_run_2026_07_10.note: Recovered by re-fetching quotes/historicals, saving raw connector outputs, normalizing output_path pointers, computing signals from files, then placing qualifying incremental orders. Valid afternoon scheduled evidence.

pointer_output_normalization_2026_07_20.trigger_incident: On Jul 20 2026 the 3:20 scheduled run collected portfolio, quotes, tradability, same-day orders, and historicals, but large historicals (and possibly other connector responses) were only available as output_path / current_session_context tool-output pointers. The background run did not persist those pointer targets into the scheduled raw directory before compute, so it escalated after data collection.
rules: Any connector response that returns an output_path or current_session_context pointer MUST be immediately copied or normalized into the run's raw directory BEFORE compute (follow the pointer, load the referenced payload, persist as parseable JSON with contents under 'data' and the original pointer under 'output_path').
Compute must read only the persisted raw files, never in-memory tool responses.
Pointer-only collection is NOT a completed run; the task must not stop after collecting data without writing run_state.

If pointer normalization fails after one bounded recovery attempt, write the valid failure-state file with a concrete error_class (e.g. pointer_normalization_failed or missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs), empty submitted_orders.csv headers where applicable, and a compact list of the missing pointer details.

recovered_run_2026_07_20.note: Parent recovery copied current_session_context / tool_calls / call_external_tool outputs into the scheduled raw directory, computed from the persisted raw files, placed scheduled top-up orders, and wrote run_state. Valid afternoon scheduled evidence.

final_scheduled_run_2026_07_16.note: Normal successful final scheduled afternoon run (no recovery, no manual override). Valid afternoon scheduled evidence. Manual/override order IDs remain excluded from all scheduled metrics.

scheduled: Write run_state.json under scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/ every time the task fires, even when no order is placed.
Update latest_scheduled_run.json to point at the just-written scheduled run.
run_classification.run_origin must be 'scheduled' and manual_run must be false.
Set order_submit_status to the true outcome; a confirmation-blocked run uses 'not_submitted_confirmation_required' and carries no order_id.
manual: NEVER update latest_scheduled_run.json from a manual run.
run_classification.run_origin must be 'manual' and manual_run must be true with a distinct run_id.
recovery_rerun: A scheduled live task's automatic failure recovery (see failure_recovery_policy in config/scheduled_tasks.json) reuses the SAME scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/ directory and stamps recovery_rerun=true on the run_state.
A recovery rerun keeps run_origin='scheduled' with BOTH cron_id='10ce362c' AND supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b' and still updates latest_scheduled_run.json; it is NEVER reclassified as manual.

If the single recovery attempt also fails or a safety/account/order rejection occurs, write run_state.json recording recovery.blocking_reason with recovery.escalated=true and escalate; do not retry further or drop to an interactive/manual path.

rules: Validate scheduled state files against run_classification.schema.json before use.

Accept BOTH run-classification-v1 and run-classification-v2-preauthorized scheduled run_state files: a v2 run_state is valid scheduled evidence when the required scheduled identity fields are correct and must not be excluded for its state_schema_version alone.
Collect every order_id found under the manual-exclusion roots (see manual_exclusion_roots) and exclude them from all scheduled-live metrics.
Exclude any run_state whose run_classification has run_origin='manual' or manual_run=true, regardless of where the file is located on disk.
Never infer scheduled status from same-day broker orders alone; a valid scheduled run_state must exist.
Scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics must be computed only from validated scheduled runs with manual order IDs excluded.

A scheduled run_state with order_submit_status='not_submitted_confirmation_required' is valid scheduled-run evidence that the task ran but is NOT evidence of an order/fill: it contributes zero scheduled fills/order IDs and must not be marked invalid because confirmation blocked submission.

Exclude final manual buy overrides (run_type='final_manual_buy_override', valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence=false, same_day_top_up_context_only=true) from scheduled slippage, scheduled fills, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost basis, and watchdog confirmation. Show them only in a labeled Manual Final Buy Override / Same-Day Top-Up Context section (see manual_reporting).

Exclude manual missed-morning recovery artifacts (under morning_dca/manual_recovery/**, run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false) from scheduled slippage, scheduled fills, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost basis, and watchdog confirmation. They never prove the 10:30 scheduled task ran and are used only as same-day prior-allocation / top-up context (see manual_missed_morning_recovery).

Exclude the 2026-07-21 manual midday run (under midday_dca/manual_runs/**, run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, stream='midday_manual', same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false, valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence=false) from scheduled slippage, scheduled fill counts, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost-basis evidence, watchdog proof, and scheduled afternoon evidence. It never proves the 12:30 or 3:20 scheduled tasks ran and is used only as same-day prior-allocation / top-up context by the later 3:20 top-up logic (see midday_manual_run_2026_07_21).

manual_exclusion_roots.reason: The 2026-07-13 final manual buy override backfilled live artifacts under midday_dca/manual_reruns/final_manual_override_* and a final_manual_review/** tree, both OUTSIDE the ce16ba6b task root. Slippage/watchdog/reporting must scan these as manual exclusions so their order IDs never leak into scheduled-live metrics.

final_buy_behavior.summary: For the final live buy of the day (the 3:20 PM ET task 10ce362c), perform a full active-universe scan and ignore the 60-minute downward-trend filter FOR THE FINAL-BUY DECISION ONLY. Every other guard still applies.
final_buy_gates: Full active-universe scan (all whitelisted tickers), not a shortlist.
Ignore the 60-minute downward-trend filter for the final-buy decision ONLY (morning 10:30 and midday 12:30 live runs still require trend validation unless changed later).
Still require current/decision price strictly below the prior completed regular-session close.
Still require multiplier > 0 from the $2-base 0x-to-5x ladder.
Still require budget pass (daily/weekly caps, buying power, per-order ceiling).
final_buy_behavior.same_day_top_up_guard: Apply the same-day top-up guard across morning, midday, manual, and final override streams: if a ticker was already bought earlier today, buy only the incremental difference max(0, final_desired_amount - prior_same_day_amount), and only if the final decision price is strictly below the LOWEST prior same-day reference price. A missing prior reference => no auto-top-up (conservative $0 / manual_review_candidate).
final_buy_behavior.trend_note: Morning (10:30) and midday (12:30) live runs still require trend validation. The trend filter is ignored ONLY for the final-buy decision on 10ce362c.

final_manual_override.summary: A final manual buy override is the final-buy behavior invoked manually (e.g. after the scheduled 3:20 PM run placed 0 orders). It ignores trend and applies same-day top-up offsets, but is manual by contract: excluded from every scheduled metric and used only as prior-allocation context for same-day top-up. Reported only in the Manual Final Buy Override / Same-Day Top-Up Context section.

final_manual_override_incident_2026_07_1.trigger: User requested final-buy behavior manually after the scheduled 3:20 PM ET run (10ce362c) had placed 0 orders. A final manual-review scan ignored trend and applied same-day top-up offsets.
final_manual_override_incident_2026_07_1.watchdog_context: The 3:40 PM watchdog alerted because broker history had orders after 3:15 PM ET but no manual-run artifacts were present under the paths it scanned. Live artifacts were backfilled with run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, run_type='final_manual_buy_override', valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence=false, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, and all order IDs.
final_manual_override_incident_2026_07_1.note: These are manual final-buy overrides and same-day top-up context only; NOT scheduled-afternoon execution evidence. Excluded from scheduled slippage, scheduled fills, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost basis, and watchdog confirmation.

rules: order_submit_status='dry_run': no live orders.
Dry-run artifacts must NOT be treated as scheduled evidence, top-up proof, slippage evidence, or confirmation that any scheduled task ran.
Excluded from scheduled reliability, fill counts, slippage, cost basis, and watchdog confirmation.

manual_missed_morning_recovery.summary: A MANUAL missed-morning recovery is a by-hand placement of the morning buys after the scheduled 10:30 AM live morning task did not run. It is manual by contract: excluded from every scheduled metric and used only as prior-allocation context for the same-day top-up guard. It is NEVER proof that the 10:30 scheduled task ran and NEVER scheduled evidence.
rules: Valid prior-allocation / top-up context ONLY when run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, and valid_scheduled_evidence=false.
Never counts as proof the 10:30 scheduled task ran.
Never written into the midday or afternoon scheduled evidence stream.
Never used for scheduled reliability, scheduled fill counts, scheduled slippage, scheduled cost basis, or watchdog confirmation.
May only reduce or block additional buys through the same-day top-up rule: buy max(0, desired - prior) only if the later decision price is strictly below the prior reference price.
The 12:30 midday run and the 3:20 final run must scan the artifact_path_pattern for same-day manual recovery artifacts and fold them into the top-up guard.

midday_manual_run_2026_07_21.summary: Manual midday run placed by hand at 1:45 PM ET on 2026-07-21. It is manual by contract: same-day top-up context ONLY. It is NEVER proof that the 12:30 or 3:20 scheduled tasks ran and is used only as prior-allocation context by the later same-day 3:20 top-up logic.
rules: Valid prior-allocation / top-up context ONLY when run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, and valid_scheduled_evidence=false.
Never counts as proof the 12:30 or 3:20 scheduled tasks ran.
May be used by later same-day 3:20 top-up logic as prior allocation context only.
Excluded from scheduled slippage, scheduled fill counts, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost-basis evidence, watchdog proof, and scheduled afternoon evidence.
Order IDs found under midday_dca/manual_runs/** are collected as excluded_manual_order_ids (see downstream_reporting_rules manual_exclusion_roots).

live_schedule_hardening_2026_07_20.trigger_incident: On Jul 20 2026 the 10:30 morning and 12:30 midday scheduled live runs both failed by invoking saved runners without first generating the same-day raw inputs and escalating without a scheduled failure-state artifact. This block applies the same self-containment and state-file guarantees to the 3:20 afternoon final live task.

raw_input_generation.summary: The 3:20 scheduled final live task MUST NOT assume runner inputs already exist. Before invoking any saved runner or order module, it MUST create the raw directory and persist all required raw inputs for the current same-day run.
required_inputs: same-day prior-allocation context from the morning-live, midday, manual missed-morning recovery, and manual override roots
historical / trend bars needed for the trend check
raw_input_generation.run_date_arg: If a runner requires a RUN_DATE_ET argument, pass the current America/New_York date as YYYYMMDD.
raw_input_generation.no_stale_reuse: Do NOT reuse stale files from a prior run.
raw_input_generation.data_sources: Finance connector primary, Alpaca and Robinhood validation/context, yfinance fallback ONLY when connector data is unavailable, stale, incomplete, or unresolved.
raw_input_generation.bounded_recovery: If raw input generation fails once, perform ONE bounded recovery attempt with the alternate approved data source path, then stop.

state_file_guarantee.summary: The 3:20 scheduled run MUST always write run_state.json, run_summary.json, and latest_scheduled_run.json even when execution is blocked, is a no-op, or errors.

blocked_state_required_fields.when: If raw inputs, trend, budget, tradability, spread, broker, or top-up conditions block execution, write a valid scheduled afternoon run_state.
blocked_state_required_fields.order_submit_status: Concrete status such as not_submitted_error or not_submitted_no_top_up.
blocked_state_required_fields.error_class: Concrete class such as missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs or no_incremental_top_up.
blocked_state_required_fields.missing_inputs_field: Include a compact list of missing files, block reasons, or failed data sources.

state_file_guarantee.evidence_meaning: This failure-state artifact is valid proof that the 3:20 scheduled task FIRED, but it is NOT order or fill evidence.
state_file_guarantee.post_raw_failure_rule: If any step fails after raw collection has started, write the signals.csv when possible, an empty submitted_orders.csv with headers when no orders were placed, and run_state.json. Do not leave a half-done run with no state file.
state_file_guarantee.manual_recovery_exclusion: Manual recovery artifacts (missed-morning under morning_dca/manual_recovery/** and manual 12:30 under midday_dca/manual_recovery/**) remain prior-allocation / top-up context only. They are NEVER afternoon scheduled evidence, slippage, reliability, fill-count, or cost-basis evidence.

order_history_persistence.reason: The 3:35 PM ET slippage task must persist the Robinhood order-history response before computing slippage, then compute average fill price and executions from the saved payload rather than re-querying the broker.

scheduled_slippage_2026_07_16.scope: afternoon scheduled (15:15-15:35 ET), final buy of the day
scheduled_slippage_2026_07_16.excluded_note: 84 manual/override order IDs excluded from the scheduled-live metrics.

rules: Include run-classification-v2-preauthorized scheduled runs in weekly metrics when the required scheduled identity fields are present; do not drop them for their state_schema_version.

If per-day slippage report files are missing, use the persisted broker order-history payloads (raw/orders_after_place.json) via dca_reporting.fills_from_order_history_payload before declaring slippage unavailable.
Manual order IDs are still excluded from weekly scheduled-live metrics.

conditions: A valid scheduled run_state exists (run_origin='scheduled', passes schema validation).
The scheduled run_state lacks order IDs due to a known/recorded write failure.
Only broker orders inside the scheduled window (15:15-15:35 ET) on the scheduled trading day may be attributed.
constraints: Manual order IDs (from manual_runs/**/run_state*.json) must still be excluded even under fallback.
Fallback is never allowed when no valid scheduled run_state exists.
Fallback must not attribute orders from a run classified as manual.
